web.note: REA can inspect websites through browser analysis.

autonomy.note: The documented workflow can inspect, explain, implement, and test a similar feature.

extensibility.note: Several agent hosts and target types are documented; no extensibility rating is stated.

setup.note: Setup uses `npx rea-agents setup`; no setup rating is stated.

bestFor.v: Source-free reverse engineering of binaries, applications, websites, mobile artifacts, firmware, and runtime behavior.

weakAt.v: Some target types require Hopper, Ghidra, IDA, JADX, a browser, or caller-supplied tools.

languages.note: Python core, laya-ts for Node/browser, and .NET SDK

modelAgnostic.note: Runs dedicated non-autoregressive encoder checkpoints (laya, laya-multilingual, laya-typed-decisions)

multiAgent.note: Integrates into CrewAI and LangGraph as a routing and decision mechanism

hosted.note: Self-hosted library, Docker, and ONNX/PyTorch runtimes

bestFor.v: Fast, deterministic System 1 routing and typed classification
bestFor.note: Evaluates decisions in a single forward pass without autoregressive generation

weakAt.v: Open-ended generation or creative text output
